shell.$description: After Graduation's page shell: the header runs edge to edge and the page is a sheet that rises over its bottom edge. On desktop the sheet sits in from the screen sides, so the header's red frames the page. Theme-only: Life Hub has no shell yet.

sheet-inset.$description: Space between the screen side and the page sheet, so the header color shows around it. Desktop only.

sheet-overlap.$description: How far the page sheet rises over the bottom of the header.

sheet-radius.$description: Rounded top corners of the page sheet.

frame.$description: The deep red the header fades to at its bottom, shown around the sheet on desktop.
